title: Sum of Two Integers
problem: Given two integers on a single line of standard input, separated by a space, print their sum.
starter_code:
# Read two integers from a single line of input, separated by a space.
# Print their sum.

# Write your code here

hints.1: Think about how to read two numbers from a single line of input.
hints.2: You can use input().split() to get the two numbers as strings, then convert each to int.
hints.3: a, b = map(int, input().split()); print(a + b)

failure_explanation: Make sure you convert the input to integers before adding them - adding the raw strings concatenates them instead of summing, and the result must be printed, not just computed or returned.
